BiblicalUsage: Pâçaç means to disappear, to vanish, to cease. The psalmist cries, Help, LORD, for the godly man ceaseth, for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one cry still fits: when the faithful seem to vanish, the psalmist does not adjust his standards, he calls on the LORD to help.
